verdict.rationale: Wave's pricing page shows that each business is signed up and billed separately, so separate businesses can exist. However, nothing in the evidence documents managing multiple legal entities together or producing consolidated financials across them. Its reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) are described per business only. Separate per-business subscriptions are an adjacent arrangement, not multi-entity consolidation.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them
